features.title: One shared plugin stylesheet
features.summary: One bundle compiles the union Tailwind sheet over every owned plugin and injects it once per page; every other plugin ships no stylesheet of its own, and an isolated plugin boot still composes the owner. The same sheet carries the generated default visual-refresh theme block (the first paint) (warm-stone palette, accent, status trios, radii, Shiki colours) that retunes the Host --dsw-* variables for native and plugin surfaces alike.
failureModes: The owner is missing from an isolated composition, so the plugin mounts with no utility rules and same-specificity base rules have nothing to resolve against.
A second bundle compiles its own copy of the sheet, so two order-dependent sheets load and a later plugin's base rule can beat an earlier plugin's responsive variant.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: One shared plugin stylesheet renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Appearance theme: presets, palette and fonts
features.summary: Settings › General › Appearance picks a colour preset (Warm stone default, Neutral, High contrast, Slate blue, Moss), optional hue, tint, accent and contrast overrides, and the UI and code fonts. The client regenerates the palette with the plugin-ui generator and injects it over the static first-paint theme only when it differs from the default, so native core surfaces (--dsw-* remap) and plugins follow at once in light and dark; theme_get reads it and theme_set changes or resets it.

onboarding.firstAction: Open Settings › General › Appearance and pick a preset, or change the accent and the interface font.
onboarding.doneWhen: The whole app takes the new colours and fonts at once, light and dark.

reach: expect text "Colour preset for every surface*"
features.currentSurface: Settings › General › Appearance; agent tools theme_get / theme_set

configuration.constraints: warm-stone, neutral, high-contrast, slate-blue or moss.
hue and accentHue 0–360, chroma 0–0.03, contrast 1–1.5; every corner keeps WCAG AA text.
geist or system; geist-mono or system. A family typed in Settings › Font still wins.

failureModes: A Host started before the Appearance settings existed reports the namespace unregistered; the client keeps the static default and injects nothing.
localStorage is unavailable (private mode, quota); the theme still applies, only a reload briefly shows the default until the settings mirror answers.

features.title: Touch platform baseline
features.summary: Page-global element rules in the shared sheet's base layer: no tap highlight or landscape text inflation, touch-action manipulation on native controls, no long-press selection on control labels under a coarse pointer, and a field floor of max(16px, inherited size) under a coarse pointer so iOS never zooms into a field.
failureModes: The baseline is unlayered, so it beats dshx: utilities: a dshx:touch-none control gets touch-action manipulation and a touch drag pans the page instead of dragging the control.
A coarse-pointer field floor reaches a field whose size is not inherited, so the field still renders under 16px and iOS zooms into it on focus.
A long-press selection rule reaches a control whose label is content, so text the user meant to copy cannot be selected.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the touch baseline styles browser state and starts no Host work of its own.
